position.title: Screen Position
position.description: Where to display this module on the mirror screen.

interval.title: Update Interval (Seconds)
interval.description: Time to wait between feed updates (e.g. 600 = 10 minutes).

max_items.title: Max Headlines
max_items.description: Maximum number of news headlines to display.

show_preamble.title: Show Preamble
show_preamble.description: Show a brief summary description under the headline.

feeds.title: News Feeds
feeds.description: List of XML RSS or Atom feeds.

name.title: Source Name
name.description: Friendly name of the news source (e.g., BBC News).

url.title: Feed URL
url.description: URL to the RSS or Atom XML feed.
